scheme_name: Financial Assistance to SC Students for Pursuing Higher Studies Abroad
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be a bonafide resident of Delhi (or domicile) for at least five years
Applicant must be the only child eligible under this scheme
Employed applicants must apply through their employer and provide a No Objection Certificate (NOC)
Applicant must not have already completed the same level of education (Master’s/Ph.D.) in India or abroad
For Ph.D. applicants, at least 55% marks or equivalent grade in the relevant Master’s degree is required
For Master’s applicants, at least 55% marks or equivalent grade in the relevant Bachelor’s degree is required
Recipients must return to India after completion and stay for at least five years
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹20 lakhs for Ph.D. programmes and up to ₹10 lakhs for Masters programmes abroad, covering tuition and living expenses.
